map.→ 打开数据压缩率工具: -> Open the data compression ratio tool
map.为何有时越压越大？: Why does more compression sometimes mean a larger value?
map.传输成本核算：估算压缩后报文节省的带宽。: Transmission cost accounting: estimate the bandwidth saved by the compressed payload.
map.压缩率=(1−压缩后/原始)×100% 表示节省比例；压缩比=原始/压缩后表示体: Compression ratio=(1−compressed/original)×100% shows the proportion saved; the compression multiple=original/compressed shows the volume factor.
map.压缩率与压缩比区别？: Difference between compression ratio and compression multiple?
map.压缩率越高越省空间，但需权衡 CPU 与耗时，实时场景未必划算。: A higher compression ratio saves more space, but CPU and elapsed time must be weighed, so in real-time scenarios it may not pay off.
map.存储优化评估：比较不同算法对日志/备份的压缩率。: Storage optimisation assessment: compare the compression ratio of different algorithms on logs and backups.
map.已压缩或随机数据无冗余，加压缩头反而略增，属正常。: Already compressed or random data has no redundancy, so adding a compression header slightly increases the size, which is normal.
map.数据压缩率计算器。输入原始大小与压缩后大小，计算压缩率与压缩比，量化压缩效果，压: Data compression ratio calculator. Enter the original and compressed sizes to get the compression ratio and the compression multiple, quantifying the compression effect; a ratio closer to 100% means stronger compression, for evaluating storage and transmission optimisation.
map.格式选型：对同类数据横向比较 gzip/zstd/zip 效果。: Format selection: compare gzip/zstd/zip results across similar data.
